helpPlay: p <i> [t...]         Play hand card i (t... are table indices to take; omit to lay it down)
rule: Take a set of table numerals that, with the card you play, adds to 11. Aces count 1 through tens 10; J, Q and K never join the sum and only take the same rank from the table. Capturing is compulsory when a capture exists. Emptying the table is a "soor": the cards from that capture score double.
promptPlay: play <i> [t...] ... play hand card i (t... are table indices)
hintReasonSoor: This empties the table -- that capture scores double
hintReasonTrail: Nothing adds to 11; lay down your least valuable card
